column1: # clues.tsv for ft_lstnew -- pedagogic hints only. NEVER state the expected value or the fix.
# Format: <hint><TAB><member CASE label><TAB>...   (fires if ANY member case fails)
Should the new node hold the very pointer it was handed, or a copy of what that pointer points to? Would a caller comparing the two see the same address?
What does malloc leave in a field you never write, and is next one of the fields you write? Where does a walk along a one-node list stop?
A caller who keeps every node it asked for frees each one later: where does each of your nodes come from, and can two calls ever hand back the same one?
